title: The story behind the score
narration: Football has more to say than the score. This is Agora Match.

title: One match. Three perspectives.
narration: One synthetic match becomes three distinct experiences. Fans follow the story. Analysts inspect evidence. Coaches prepare focused reviews.

title: Follow the match
narration: Play the match, follow the ball, and jump straight to key moments. The replay uses fictional events and illustrative tracking.

title: Why this moment matters
narration: At a corner, Agora connects the current moment with both teams' recent set piece history. Every claim keeps its sample size and source.

title: Ask. Inspect. Understand.
narration: Ask the match in plain language. Open the supporting facts, then follow an event link back to the pitch.

title: Find the tactical evidence
narration: Analysts can find tagged winger versus fullback encounters, and inspect each outcome alongside prior player positions.

title: Evidence follows the clock
narration: Rewind to twenty minutes. Later evidence disappears. The score becomes nil nil, and eight tagged encounters become one.

title: The player perspective
narration: Follow any player for position specific metrics, a movement heatmap, historical context, and a transparent demo rating.

title: Review cues with context
narration: Coaches get qualified review cues. Lower sampled running output and wider spacing trigger questions, not fatigue diagnoses or assumed marking errors.

title: From insight to broadcast
narration: Package a finding as a timed broadcast card, with machine readable evidence and an expiry.

title: A checked AI handoff
narration: An optional Microsoft Foundry workflow separates analysis, audience narration, and review. Code preserves fact values. This public demo uses deterministic answers. Live model evaluation remains pending.

title: Ask the match. See the evidence.
narration: Explore two fictional matches. Ask, inspect, and share the story behind the score.
